data.name: Ghareebah
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghareebah means 'Stranger' or 'Foreigner'. This name is derived from the root 'G-H-R' which signifies 'strangeness' or 'otherness'. In Islamic spirituality, the term can also symbolize a seeker of truth, someone who is different yet remains steadfast in their beliefs.
